title: Austin Officials Adopt Past Records Quickly
summary:
*   **Administrative Focus:** The meeting's primary goal was to approve official records from the previous year.
*   **Year-Long Review:** All city meeting minutes from January through December 1947 were read and reviewed.
*   **Records Unanimously Approved:** City officials unanimously voted to formally adopt the 1947 records.
*   **No New Business:** No other new policies, public hearings, or significant decisions were addressed at this session.
transcript:
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
96
MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
Recessed Meeting
February 09, 1948
3:00 P. M.
Council Chamber, City Hall
The meeting was called to order, with Mayor Miller presiding. Roll call: Present:
Councilmen Bartholomew, Johnson, Mayor Miller, and Councilman Thornberry - 4
Absent: Councilman Glass 1
Present also: Guiton Morgan, City Manager The Minutes of the City Council for the year
1947, beginning with the Regular Meeting of January 2, 1947, up to and including the
Recessed Meeting of December 24, 1947, were read. Councilman Thornberry moved that the
Minutes be adopted, as read. The motion carried by the following vote: Ayes: Councilmen
Bartholomew, Johnson, Mayor Miller, and Councilman Thornberry
Noes: None
Absent: Councilman Glass.
There being no further business, upon motion of Councilman Thornberry, the meeting was
recessed, subject to call of the Mayor, by the following vote: Ayes: Councilmen
Bartholomew, Johnson, Mayor Miller, and Councilman Thornberry
Noes: None
Attest:
Hallia Miella
City Clerk
Jon Milla.
Approved:
Mayor
